task.title: Improve doc search thoroughness in festina-create
task.description: Update the refine_doc_links step in the festina-create skill to extract comprehensive keywords from the full ticket description and use glossary expansion before searching, improving doc discovery.
task.problem: The refine_doc_links step in festina-create extracts only a handful of keywords (3-6) from the full ticket description, causing relevant documentation to be missed. Additionally, the expand-query glossary command exists in the CLI but is never called by any skill, so synonym expansion defined in glossary.yaml is dormant.
task.value: More relevant docs get linked to tasks automatically, improving context availability during scoping and implementation. This reduces the chance of developers missing existing patterns or related features when working on a task.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a completed Q&A with problem, value, and acceptance criteria When the refine_doc_links step runs Then it extracts all meaningful terms (10-20 keywords covering nouns, verbs, domain terms, technical terms, system names) from the full ticket text And not just a selective handful
Given extracted keywords When searching for docs Then expand-query is called first to include glossary synonyms And the expanded terms are passed to search-product and search-engineering
Given the same ticket description When comparing old vs new approach Then the new approach surfaces at least as many relevant docs as the old one (no regression)
